THE SHUBHAM K MART GUIDELINES04 / 20
A CONSISTENT BRAND ANCHOR

One clear anchor.
The right color version.

Select the logo by its background first, then place it on the format grid. Transparent yellow belongs on Brand Green only; transparent green belongs on Brand Gold only. Keep the brand anchor consistent within each template.

¼ × symbol width
PROPOSED CLEAR-SPACE RULE
LET THE MARK BREATHE

Space is part
of the signature.

The boundary is an exclusion zone, not a border to export. Measure from the visible mark, and review the complete lockup at the intended size.

01

Choose the surface first

Use only #3D6948 behind the yellow transparent logo and #F3CB2D behind the green transparent logo. Other backgrounds require the complete original boxed artwork.

02

Clear space

Proposed minimum: 0.25 × the symbol width on each side. Measure from the visible mark rather than empty SVG canvas.

03

Minimum size

Test a 32 px symbol and a 160 px full lockup. The supplied square artwork may need a larger display size so its original wordmark remains readable.

04

Responsive placement

Recompose the layout for narrow screens. Preserve the logo aspect ratio, readable size and clear space; never stretch the image to fill a container.
